# iosxe_voice_class_sip_copylist (Data Source)

This data source can read the Voice Class SIP Copylist configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iosxe_voice_class_sip_copylist" "example" {
  tag = 100
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag` (Number) Voice class sip-copylist tag

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `headers` (Set of String) Header name of header to be sent to peer leg
- `id` (String) The path of the retrieved object.
- `sip_header_req_uri` (Boolean) SIP Request URI to be sent to peer leg
- `sip_header_status_line` (Boolean) SIP Status-Line to be sent to peer leg
